name: How long does it take to frame a standard door opening?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to frame a standard door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to frame a standard door opening depends on whether it's a new opening in an existing wall, part of a new construction, or replacing an old frame. For a straightforward interior, non-load-bearing wall, framing a new opening can typically be completed within a day. If it's a load-bearing wall, an exterior opening, or involves significant demolition, it might extend to a few days due to additional structural work, permitting, and inspections. We aim to minimize disruption and complete projects efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a standard interior door can take a day; load-bearing or exterior openings may take longer due to complexity, permits, and inspections.
